title: 3.2.4c Lab — Add a Torus
description: Create a Torus with distinct ringRadius and tubeRadius values — the only shPlay shape with two radii.

steps.title: Create a Torus with two different radii
steps.instructions: In setup(), write `ring = new Torus(0, 0, 0, 1.5, 0.3)` — ring radius 1.5, tube radius 0.3.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and find the Torus section. Note it takes two radius arguments, not one.

steps.title: Give it a color
steps.instructions: Set `ring.color = 'gold'` or any color you like.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and check the color property.
